# YUM Network

> YUM Network provides public information about its services, policies, privacy practices, and support. Its reporting workspace requires authentication and is not public documentation.

## Public Pages

- [Home](https://report.yumnetwork.vn/): Overview of YUM Network services and support information.
- [Terms of Service](https://report.yumnetwork.vn/terms): Terms governing use of YUM Network services.
- [Privacy Policy](https://report.yumnetwork.vn/privacy): Information about data collection, use, retention, and user rights.
- [Data Deletion](https://report.yumnetwork.vn/data-deletion): Instructions for requesting access to or deletion of personal data.

## Contact

- Privacy and data requests: privacy@yumnetwork.vn
